text:
maria gonzales: Heads-up — ACME wants a clear upgrade story when we hand them the private distro next month. They insist on zero-IP-rewrite and a rollback path.
ashok rao: Noted. Zero-IP-rewrite is doable but we need operator compatibility guarantees. which operator versions do they run?
devon li: ACME runs a locked 1.18 cluster with strict IPAM. They can't accept any change that forces renumbering.
maria gonzales: Right — field asked for an installer we can run offline and an operator pinning option (no automatic controller upgrades). Also wants a short rollback playbook.
ajulie: +1 on rollback playbook. We should add explicit acceptance criteria: 1) network-preserve test passes; 2) install can be performed without internet; 3) operator pinned via `imagePullPolicy`/tag manifest.
ashok rao: For (1) we need e2e that simulates IP takeover and ensures BGP sessions stay stable. I'll scope a light test harness.
devon li: Packaging question: do we ship a full container tarball or an airgap bundle + a single repo of manifests? field prefers tarball with SHA-sums.
maria gonzales: Field feedback: tarball + manifest index is preferred. Also metadata.json with version, supported kernel list, and exact operator tag.
ajulie: Can we include a tiny launcher script that validates preflight (disk, ports, iptables)? Example: `./redwood-install --preflight`
sre-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — any change that touches handshake protocol needs security review and a rolling upgrade plan.
ashok rao: Regarding handshake: customers want to keep control-plane egress minimal. We should support a mode where control-plane callbacks are optional and only to `status.redwood.local` when allowed.
devon li: That impacts licensing and metrics. We can add an opt-out for telemetry; but SLA-related features will require a signed offline license file.
maria gonzales: Let's align scope for the upcoming sprint: - Minimal deliverable: airgap tarball + manifests + preflight script + operator pinning support + rollback runbook. - Stretch: BGP e2e harness, offline license flow, IP-preserve cert tests.
ajulie: Acceptance criteria proposal (small): 
- Installer runs in <15m in isolated env (no internet)
- Upgrade path: kube-operator pinned -> new images applied only when `--apply-upgrade` passed
- Rollback tested and time-to-restore <20m in lab
- Customer-managed networking: docs for BGP/peering and an automated `net-preserve` check
maria gonzales: If we all agree, I'll put these in the PRD and tag engineering/qa to estimate. Any objections?
ashok rao: Fine from infra. Need 2 sprint lead time for BGP harness.
devon li: Devex: we need sample CF templates and an example IP-preserve config to ship with the bundle. I'll draft.
ajulie: I'll write the rollback runbook and preflight checklist.
sre-bot: incident-bot: flagged for follow-up — add security review to sprint ticket.
maria gonzales: Great — I'll create the scope ticket and loop legal for license wording. Thanks team :rocket:
